# meshmsg v0.1.15

This security-hardening release makes private-message replay protection restart-safe and strengthens peer-directory consistency and presence ordering.

## Security and correctness

- Persists accepted direct-message IDs atomically in owner-only, recipient/topic-bound state before delivery, preventing authenticated replay after daemon restart.
- Bounds persistent replay state and fails closed when capacity is exhausted.
- Derives replay retention from the direct-message acceptance window with an explicit safety margin.
- Uses signed presence record IDs as deterministic tie-breakers when issuance timestamps are equal.
- Reduces accepted future skew for presence records from five minutes to 60 seconds, limiting clock-based directory freezing.
- Keeps endpoint-only presence changes internal instead of emitting observable `peer_updated` events.

## Peer-directory protocol

- Adds a random daemon-lifetime `directory_epoch` and contiguous `directory_revision` lifecycle cursor to snapshots and events.
- Introduces the fail-closed `peer_directory_v2` IPC capability and schema.
- Makes the web client refresh authoritative state when it detects an epoch change or revision gap.

## Validation

- Adds restart replay, presence ordering/skew, route-only update, schema, and web projection coverage.
- Updates compatibility checks and protocol documentation.

Restart running daemons after installation. Clients and daemons using the peer-directory API must be upgraded together because v2 intentionally does not fall back to v1.

Install this exact source release:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.15 --locked --force
```
